title: fold
content_html:
fold

A fold can hide an area, leave a crease or bring distant parts of one surface together. Folding forms and creases give two ways to think about the operation and what remains visible afterwards. In a text or a memory, two passages or times can come into contact while the distance between them still exists. What new connection becomes visible at the fold? Folding forms 1

Reading note. Daoism. Chapter 2 of the Zhuangzi imagines a pivot from which what is called “this” or “that” can turn. A fold can likewise bring two parts of a surface into contact. Can a turn bring both sides into view, and what remains concealed when it does? Zhuangzi, 2
